topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't believe this. So, this whole time, we've been chatting, sharing, laughing over texts and calls, and this person is right here, in the same damn city. All those times I asked, and they gave me some convoluted story about how far away they were. I feel like I've been played. Now, I see them around, they act like it's all casual, like they didn’t keep this a big secret. I can’t even look at them without thinking about it. What a mess.
